videos.title: Everyone's watching the wrong AI scoreboard #AI #OpenAI #AInews #tech #bigtech
videos.description:
For two years, one number ran the entire AI industry: who has the best model this month. Every launch, every earnings call, every leak got scored against it, and that scoreboard justified the biggest capital buildout in the history of technology. It was not irrational. The model race was real and it produced real jumps.

But the tell is what the leaders are doing now. When the companies at the front quietly stop competing on the thing everyone else is still measuring, the game has already moved.
